name: Giorgio Tedesco

disambiguatingDescription: Giorgio Tedesco is a Technology Executive and Solution Architect specializing in Software Engineering and 3D Graphics. He is distinct from the legal professional 'Avvocato Giorgio Tedesco'. His focus is on Digital Transformation and System Design.
